name: FM-106
intro: A 6-voice Roland Juno-106 (KR-106 port) with its BBD stereo chorus and all 128 factory patches: turn PRESETS, then ALGORITHM for bank B, and play.

rows.what: VCF page: FREQ, RES, ENV, LFO. Also backs out of menus.
Next page: VCF, VCF 2, DCO, DCO 2, ENV, LFO, ARP, FX.
Step through the same 8 pages, both directions.
KNOB 1-4 move the four sliders shown on the page.
Octave down (OCT+ up), up to 2; lit when shifted.
Browse the 64 patches of the current bank (A11-A88).
Bank: FACT A, FACT B, USER A, USER B.
Arpeggiator on / off; ARP lights while on.
Arp MODE UP, U&D, DN; KNOB 3 rate, KNOB 4 octaves.
VCA mode ENV / GATE (organ-style on / off).
Filter cutoff; KNOB 2 resonance (self-oscillates).
Filter envelope amount; KNOB 4 filter LFO amount.
VCF 2: KBD tracking, INV envelope, bend depths.
DCO: RNG 16'/8'/4', PULSE, SAW, SUBSW on / off.
One page left: DCO 2: SUB, NOISE, PWM, DCOLFO.
ENV (ADSR): ATK, DEC, SUS, REL.
LFO: RATE, DELAY, PWM MD (LFO or MAN).
FX (CHORUS) page: CHO, HPF, VCA, LEVEL.
The Juno chorus: OFF, I, II, I+II; FX lights when on.
HPF: BST bass boost, FLT flat, 236 Hz, 754 Hz.
Patch output LEVEL.
Quick save: factory sound to first empty user slot; user slot overwritten.
Half a second: SAVE PRESET screen; SAVE lights.
In it: choose the slot, UA11 to UB88.
Move the name cursor; PRESETS changes the letter.
Commit the save; HOME leaves without saving.
Delete the chosen user slot (second press confirms).
OPTIONS menu: MIDI SETUP, ABOUT; GLO again closes.
Open MIDI SETUP; SELECT picks CHANNEL or SYNC.
Change the chosen value (channel 1-16, sync).

tips: Edits are lost when you turn PRESETS; tap SAVE first. Factory patches are never overwritten, a quick save goes to a user slot named *Name.
An empty user slot (USER A / USER B) loads a plain saw init patch: a clean start for your own sound.
The 106 classic: a saw or pulse pad with chorus II, or I+II for the fast vibrato-like shimmer.
Over USB MIDI it plays on any channel and takes CCs: 74 cutoff, 71 resonance, 73/75/70/72 attack/decay/sustain/release, 1 DCO LFO, 64 sustain pedal. It is also a USB audio interface.
Something wrong after an update? Hold OCT- while powering on: USB rescue screen for reinstalling. Holding OCT-, OCT+ and HOME for 5 s also enters UPDATE MODE.
checked: Beta4 hub archive, src/fm106.c FM1_SLOTS + page titles: 8 pages VCF (FREQ RES ENV LFO), VCF 2 (KBD INV B.DCO B.VCF), DCO (RNG PULSE SAW SUBSW), DCO 2 (SUB NOISE PWM DCOLFO), ENV (ADSR) (ATK DEC SUS REL), LFO (RATE DELAY PWM MD -), ARPEGGIATOR (ARP MODE ARAT ARNG), FX (CHORUS) (CHO HPF VCA LEVEL). Value names N_RNG, N_ARMD, N_CHOR, N_HPF, N_VCA, N_PWMD.

fm106.c app_main buttons: OCT-/OCT+ -2..+2 with LEDs; GLO toggles OPTIONS menu; FX -> PAGE_FX; HOME -> PAGE_VCF or backs out of SAVE/MIDI/MENU; EDIT next page mod 8; ENV -> PAGE_ENVELOPE; LFO -> PAGE_LFO; ARP -> PAGE_ARP (jump only, arp on/off is KNOB 1); SEL normal = vca_mode toggle, in MENU opens MIDI SETUP, in SAVE delete with confirm.

fm106.c SAVE: release before 500 ms = fm106_do_short_save (factory -> first blank user slot with '*'+name, 'USER BANKS FULL!' if none; user -> overwrite); held 500 ms -> UI_MODE_SAVE (SELECT slot 0..127 = UA11..UB88, ALGORITHM cursor 0..14, PRESETS char, SAVE commit, HOME back/cancel).

fm106.c encoders normal mode: PRESETS = fm106_find_next_preset (wraps within bank of 64), ALGORITHM = bank 0..3 keeping slot number, SELECT = page; KNOB1-4 per-page params; LED BTN_FX = chorus on, BTN_ARP = arp_on.

fm106.c MIDI in: no channel filter; CCs 0/32 bank, 74 71 76 77 78 73 75 70 72 1 79 9 13 80 81 82 7/11 12 93 64 119; program change within bank. fm106_sysex.h fm106_load_user_preset: blank user slot = init saw patch. 128 factory names in fm106_presets.h.
platform.c line 6/441 + bootguard.h: OCT- alone at power-on = USB rescue; platform.c 353: OCT- + OCT+ + HOME held 5 s = UPDATE MODE.
unsure: manual.html in the archive describes a sequencer (SEQ/PLAY/REC), TAPE effect, 10 pages, MIDI IN/OUT/LOCAL/PC IN menu and a big CC map; none of this exists in the Beta4 source (no BTN_SEQ/PLAY/REC handling, only CHANNEL + SYNC in MIDI SETUP). Not used; manual link points to the repo README instead.
README says FX cycles the chorus mode and ARP toggles the arpeggiator; code only jumps to the FX / ARP page (KNOB 1 changes it). Sheet follows the code.

MIDI SETUP SYNC (OFF/MASTER/SLAVE) is stored but never used anywhere in the code; CHANNEL only sets the channel of sent program/bank changes (panel notes go out on channel 1, input is omni). Kept vague in the sheet.
CC 93 in code: >80 = chorus II, >40 = I, else OFF (I+II not reachable by CC), differs from manual.html. Not on the sheet.
Arp rate is free-running (no clock sync) as far as read; arp engine details not deeply checked. DIN MIDI input path not checked, so the tip says USB MIDI only.
